description: 【名古屋市】指定緊急避難場所(地震・大規模な火事)【広域避難場所】一覧表 [evacuation shelters and public facilities and earthquakes] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 名古屋市. 指定緊急避難場所（地震・大規模な火事）【広域避難場所】の一覧です。. Coverage: 名古屋市. The portal files it under the publisher 名古屋市. Its tags are 名古屋市, 地震, 広域避難場所, 指定緊急避難場所, 施設一覧. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2024-10-30 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
